case.title: Multichain Fantom bridge (MPC address), Ethereum, 6 Jul 2023
case.period: hack: baseline before the incident, then the drain
case.notes: The vault is an EOA (MPC-controlled), so every release is a direct token transfer by it. Ordinary small user releases continue inside the hack window; theft_min_usd separates them. first_theft_tx is a 2 USDC test at 16:21 UTC; measure detection from first_large_theft_tx (27.65M USDC, 18:10 UTC).
case.coverage: Ethereum-side Fantom bridge only (Moonriver/Dogechain losses not included). Reports point to misuse of MPC keys rather than a contract bug: abnormal MPC outflows.

price_note: Stablecoins and FRAX at $1; WBTC at Chainlink BTC / USD 30,419.40; WETH at Chainlink ETH / USD 1,888.63; LINK at Chainlink LINK / USD 6.18 (answers at block 17635954). Native ETH is not included except where it passed through WETH (rows with kind weth_wrap / weth_unwrap).
